name: curses_ui_token_score
notes: Fuzzy token scorer (src/hermes_cli/curses_ui.c::curses_token_score vs LIVE hermes_cli/curses_ui.py::_token_score). Traces per-char find/contiguous-run/penalty/boundary/first-char branches, prefix + exact-match bonuses, and the final %.17g score value. No-match returns -1.0 on both sides (LIVE None normalized to -1.0). Inputs are label/token pairs.
